g.text: Bridge output: neither speaker pin connects to GND. Keep speaker pair short / twisted.

g.desc: Bridge output: neither speaker pin connects to GND. Keep speaker pair short / twisted.

g.text: Do not connect a powered ISP source and USB power together.

g.desc: Do not connect a powered ISP source and USB power together.

g.text: Program bootloader and fuses through J2 before USB serial uploads can work.

g.desc: Program bootloader and fuses through J2 before USB serial uploads can work.

g.text: Use Arduino Uno / ATmega328P / 16 MHz / Optiboot, 115200 baud.

g.desc: Use Arduino Uno / ATmega328P / 16 MHz / Optiboot, 115200 baud.

g.text: R8/R9 set a conservative starting volume. Tune by listening; do not assume a 3 W output.

g.desc: R8/R9 set a conservative starting volume. Tune by listening; do not assume a 3 W output.

g.text: DTR falling edge resets U1 through C10. D1 clamps the positive reset pulse.

g.desc: DTR falling edge resets U1 through C10. D1 clamps the positive reset pulse.

g.text: U4 limits turn-on slew before downstream bulk capacitors. Verify inrush on hardware.

g.desc: U4 limits turn-on slew before downstream bulk capacitors. Verify inrush on hardware.

g.text: Separate 5.1k CC pull-downs. USB-C data and power; no PD negotiation.

g.desc: Separate 5.1k CC pull-downs. USB-C data and power; no PD negotiation.

g.text: A0 remains externally floating, as on the prototype, for the existing randomSeed call.

g.desc: A0 remains externally floating, as on the prototype, for the existing randomSeed call.

g.text: 16 MHz resonator includes load capacitors. AREF is decoupled, not tied to +5V.

g.desc: 16 MHz resonator includes load capacitors. AREF is decoupled, not tied to +5V.
